reasons.plausibility: The proposed role of Co in modifying stacking fault energy and hence twin formation is consistent with accepted metallurgical principles.
reasons.testability: A controlled two-alloy test with microstructural analysis under variable strain rates and temperatures allows a clear falsification if no difference in twinning or mechanical response is observed.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how composition influences dynamic behavior of these high-entropy alloys, offering clear design insights for tuning mechanical properties.
